data.subject: EJF Capital public-records weekly
data.body:
Hi,

EJF Capital LP’s most recent 13F, for the period June 30, 2026, shows positions in COSO, CBK, and FRST.

On August 14, 2026, OPTU received a delisting or listing-standard notice in an 8-K Item 3.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1702780/000170278026000052/optu-20260813.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only, never issuer-paid. I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot.

Andrew

Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
